scripts.types: jco guest-types ../contracts/c4-pipeline/wit --world-name c4-compiler-core -o generated/compiler && jco guest-types ../contracts/c4-pipeline/wit --world-name excalidraw-policy-component -o generated/policy
scripts.build: pnpm run check && mkdir -p dist/js && tsc --noEmit false --outDir dist/js --rootDir src && jco componentize dist/js/c4-compiler.js --wit ../contracts/c4-pipeline/wit --world-name c4-compiler-core --disable all -o dist/c4-compiler.wasm && jco componentize dist/js/excalidraw-policy.js --wit ../contracts/c4-pipeline/wit --world-name excalidraw-policy-component --disable all -o dist/excalidraw-policy.wasm && jco wit dist/c4-compiler.wasm > dist/c4-compiler.wit && jco wit dist/excalidraw-policy.wasm > dist/excalidraw-policy.wit
